chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Washa, from Musanna, from a man, from Abu Abdillah, from his father (peace be upon him)
That the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to pelt the Jamarah while walking.
ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) stone the Jamarah while walking or riding?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted through the chain of al-Kulayni in *Al-Kafi*, establishes the Sunnah of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) performing the Rami al-Jamarat while walking, which serves as a primary evidentiary basis for the permissibility of this method in Shia jurisprudence. It highlights the physical ease and flexibility granted in ritual worship, contrasting with or complementing the practice of pelting while riding, thereby offering practical guidance for pilgrims of varying physical capacities.
